subject: [hw] IP -> IV: fixed - archive build now precedes extraction; always rebuilds from current sources
body: Caught and fixed: build_ios.sh was extracting before the auto-build on a cold /tmp, leaving VHOST_OBJS empty. The order is now: build/reuse archive, then extract, then link. It also always runs `make ios-lib` from current IV sources when the SDK is present (N2VHOST_IOS_LIB overrides), because a stale archive hid three new symbols (pthread_key_create, pthread_setspecific, strnlen). Fresh product link: vcodecd 391536 B, V32/V33 shims present, no fake hardware, N2TEST IP PASS 763/763.
